Title: Vinod's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vinod - 31 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Shalini - 56 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Rajesh - 32 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Kavita - 29 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
5. Meenakshi - 25 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vinod is asleep in bed in the ward. Shalini and Kavita stand near him.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[After a long illness Vinod passes away in his hospital bed.]

Shalini: "We have to be strong now."
